source: docs/L7V2_DESIGN.md section 10 (the live set and R*), section 11 (outcomes, the verdict ladder, units, statistics, effect sizes, the testing order) and section 13 item 4, approved 2026-10-30 as recommended (D-021); ml/l7v2_model_prereg.json baselines.age_only (D-034); the user's decisions D-043 (E-3) and D-044 (OC-1..OC-4); the user's decisions D-051 and D-053, the orchestrator's D-054 (T-048's findings T048-01, -02, -04, -12, -13)
rule: Section 13 item 4, re-registered 2026-11-02 under the user's decisions D-051 ('Fix as recommended') and D-053 ('210 s + level window') and the orchestrator's D-054 (T048-12), post hoc but before any capture and before the code that reads it: it replaces ml/l7v2_verdict_prereg_v2.json (format 2), which T-048's review found could judge V-C with every V-A condition holding, and let an arm over the budget carry V-B or V-C. The verdict code claims one verdict under these resolutions. A change is a new file version, labelled post hoc in the design's As-built section; tests pin every value.

minimum_cut.use: section 14's fallback only, decided before the campaign; never after a block

best_rule.definition: R* is the rule arm with the best validation recall at the common budget (section 10)
best_rule.candidates_reading: the four tuned rule arms whose section-10 row says 'the best of the rule arms runs live' or 'may be the live rule'; the population-level detector (replay only, C1's detector) and the fixed replays (default rules, tolerant rules, nginx limits; untuned) are reported, never R*
best_rule.data: validation captures only, frozen in the selection before the first evaluation block

primary.harm: Q in the level window on judged links (design 5.2), in percent: from the attack's start + level_window.from_attack_start_s to the attack's end (D-053)
primary.benign_acted_on: benign users wrongly acted on at level 1 or level 2, per run, attributed from the manifest

secondary: Q over the whole attack window
time to mitigate: attack start to the first 5 consecutive 1-s bins with Q >= 99 %
time to decision per attack entity
attack cost left, per class and arm (ml/p1_prereg_2.json)

detection.source: the replay of each U run's recording through every arm at its frozen operating point (the same traffic for every arm)
metrics: entity recall at the frozen operating point
benign FP per benign kind, held-out kinds included

units.block: one evaluation seed with its own IP pool

harm.pairing: by block, keyed by block: lists with different key sets are refused (D-054, T048-12)
harm.supported: at least min_blocks blocks, the 95 % t-interval of the mean block difference excludes 0, and at least same_sign_share of the blocks have the sign of the mean (run_level_stats.decide)

stages: attack entities with replacement within each drawn block
detection.statistic: the difference of pooled entity recall between two arms on the same resampled entities, in pp

power.when: every harm contrast that is not shown

effect_sizes.harm_beats: the paired contrast is supported in the arm's favour and its mean is >= harm_beats_pp of Q
effect_sizes.harm_equivalence: the 95 % t-interval of the paired contrast lies strictly inside +-harm_equivalence_pp, over at least min_blocks blocks
effect_sizes.detection_beats: the recall difference is >= detection_beats_pp and its bootstrap interval excludes 0
effect_sizes.detection_equivalence: the bootstrap interval of the recall difference lies strictly inside +-detection_equivalence_pp
effect_sizes.loses: the other arm beats this one by the same rule

testing_order_rule: harm_admission passes when the class is admitted; budget when at least one contender (R*, HGB, GRU) meets the budget; mitigation when some live M has Q(M) - Q(U) supported and, for a class admitted on latency alone, some live M's mean gain is >= latency_alone.min_mean_gain_pp. v_a is then an intersection-union test of all V-A's conditions (R-3), with no gate on the best learned arm. Only when it does not hold, the fixed sequence best_learned_vs_rstar, gru_vs_hgb, gru_vs_shuffled decides V-B, V-C or inconclusive, at alpha 0.05 for each step (R-9).

ladder.name: no advantage, or no harm
ladder.when: U fails harm admission; or no contender (R*, HGB, GRU) meets the budget on the evaluation seeds; or no arm mitigates (Q(M) - Q(U) not supported in M's favour for any live M of the class); or the class was admitted on latency alone and no live M's mean gain Q(M) - Q(U) is >= 5 pp

ladder.name: the GRU beats all
ladder.when: the GRU meets the budget, beats every live baseline arm of the class on harm, and beats the HGB and the shuffled-GRU on detection by >= 10 pp

ladder.name: learning helps, sequence does not
ladder.when: the best learned arm beats R* on harm and meets the budget, and the GRU is not V-A because it is equivalent to the HGB or to the shuffled-GRU on detection, or loses to one of them

ladder.name: rules suffice
ladder.when: the best learned arm is equivalent to R* on harm, or R* beats it on harm (OC-4: 'rules suffice or win'), and R* meets the budget

ladder.name: none of the above
ladder.when: no rung above holds: reported with the power calculation, no verdict claimed; a V-B or V-C whose carrier is over the budget is inconclusive with the arm named (D-051)

ladder_rule: per class, the first rung that holds, in the order listed (V-D, V-A, V-B, V-C, inconclusive)

age_only.rule: the age-only baseline's validation AUC must lie within 0.5 +- band (ml/l7v2_model_prereg.json baselines.age_only); outside it every view-level result is age-confounded and V-A is not claimed

benign_model.rule: a C3b result against a structureless benign model cannot support V-A (design 12.1); as built the trained benign navigation is TPC-W browsing (design As built), so the runner states it per class

record.rule: only a frozen calibration record gives a verdict (ml/l7v2_prereg.json harm.verdict_record); a placeholder or measured record is refused

readings.text: Harm contrasts are differences of Q in pp, arm minus comparator, paired by block, judged by eval/run_level_stats.decide and t_interval unchanged.

Detection contrasts compare the arms' replays of the same U runs: the difference of pooled entity recall at each arm's frozen operating point, with the two-stage cluster bootstrap of statistics.detection.

V-A's conditions are tested first and jointly, as an intersection-union test: the GRU beats every live arm of the class on harm, and the HGB and the shuffled-GRU on detection, each contrast at alpha 0.05 and all 'beats'; an intersection-union test needs no multiplicity adjustment and no gate on the HGB [INFERENCE: Berger 1982]. OC-1's best learned arm is used for V-B and V-C only (D-051).
V-B's 'equivalent to, or loses to, the HGB or the shuffled-GRU' uses the detection contrasts of V-A (the shuffled-GRU never runs live, so it has no harm runs).
V-D's mitigation test is run_level_stats.decide of Q(M) - Q(U) per live M of the class; 'supported (+)' for at least one M means some arm mitigates.
When the V-A conditions hold but a V-A block applies (age-confounded, structureless benign model), the class is inconclusive with the block named; V-B, V-C and V-D are unaffected.
The shuffled-GRU of the ladder is the plain variant (models.gru_shuffled); the pin_first variant is reported beside it and is never judged.
The detection bootstrap's seed is fixed here for reproducibility; it judges nothing.

[INFERENCE, disclosed] With V-A tested before the fixed sequence, the family-wise bound is no longer 0.05 in every case. Where the best learned arm is the GRU, V-A's and V-B's harm claims need the same contrast, so the bound stays 0.05. Where the HGB leads validation (C3b only), V-A rests on GRU vs R* and V-B on HGB vs R*: with both nulls true a false claim of either has probability at most 0.10 by the union bound. A verdict is one rung, each rung's own claim is at 0.05.

label: re-registered 2026-11-02 under D-051, D-053 and D-054, post hoc but before any capture

detection_entities.label: D-043, E-3
detection_entities.rule: a class's detection contrasts (steps gru_vs_hgb and gru_vs_shuffled, V-A, V-B) read its primary families' attack entities only; the families reported separately get their own contrasts, descriptive, which judge nothing

choices.question: Which arm is 'the best learned arm' of V-B and V-C (it matters for C3b only, where the GRU and the HGB both run live)? V-A does not use it (D-051).

options.eval_q: the live learned arm with the higher mean Q over the evaluation blocks (ties: the GRU)
options.validation: the live learned arm with the higher validation recall at the budget, frozen in the selection before evaluation (ties: the GRU)
options.gru: the GRU, the design's focal arm

choices.question: On which measure does an arm 'meet the budget on the evaluation seeds' (V-A, V-B's and V-C's carriers, V-D)?

options.replay: its benign units flagged in the replay of the U runs at its frozen operating point, pooled over the evaluation blocks, <= floor(0.01 x the benign units pooled)
options.live: the benign users wrongly acted on (level 1 or 2) in its own M runs, pooled over the evaluation blocks, <= floor(0.01 x the benign users pooled)

choices.reported_beside: replay: the arm's benign units flagged in the replay of the U runs is reported beside the live reading and judges nothing

choices.question: Does V-A's 'every live baseline arm' include U?

options.with_u: every live arm of the class other than the GRU, U included
options.detectors_only: the live detector arms only (default rules, R*, HGB), U excluded

choices.question: What is the verdict when R* beats the best learned arm on harm (no rung of section 11 names that case)?

options.inconclusive: inconclusive, as the table's 'none of the above'
options.v_c: V-C, read as 'rules suffice or win'

level_window.admission: harm admission stays as registered: dQ and dL over the whole attack window (ml/l7v2_prereg.json harm); the level window is read by the verdict's harm contrasts only

carriers.rule: an arm over the budget cannot carry V-B or V-C: the class is inconclusive, the arm named

budget_step.counts: the contenders R*, HGB and GRU only; the default rules are the status quo and are reported, never counted

latency_alone.rule: a class whose admission passed on the p95 criterion and not on the Q criterion gets V-D unless some live M's mean gain Q(M) - Q(U) over the blocks is >= 5 pp: Q is the only harm outcome the ladder reads

always_reported.rule: for an admitted class every GRU contrast is computed and reported whatever the verdict: on harm against every live arm of the class, on detection against the HGB, the shuffled-GRU, R* and, descriptively, the age-only arm
